description: ChatHLS bug_database.pdf → debug/repair skill overlay. Source: test-chathls/ChatHLS-ACL-26/src/knowledge_repo/bug_database.pdf. Load via C2HLS_FLASH_SKILL_ENTRIES_JSON or merge into packaged skills for debug/repair stages.

skills.pattern: Vitis HLS csim/csynth/cosim failure or suspicious latency/II after pragma changes; classify against ChatHLS bug_database error types APT, DFP, DID, FND, MLP, OOB, RAMB, SMA
skills.strategy: Route the failure to exactly one ChatHLS debug catalog class before editing: APT=array_partition type; DID=partition dim; FND=partition factor not divisible; DFP=dataflow process/buffer legality; MLP=missing/misplaced pipeline; OOB=out-of-bounds index; RAMB=random access vs burst/m_axi; SMA=scalar vs memory/array interface mismatch. Apply only that class's fix; do not conflate APT/DID/FND.
required_steps: collect the HLS error/warning IDs and the nearby pragma/array/loop
map to one catalog code (APT|DFP|DID|FND|MLP|OOB|RAMB|SMA)
open the matching chathls-debug-* skill and apply its required_steps
verify with csim then csynth (cosim when enabled)
if still failing, re-classify rather than stacking unrelated pragmas
guards: prefer one root-cause class per repair round
APT vs DID vs FND are distinct — do not change type/dim/factor together without evidence
skills.template: CLASSIFY → pick one of APT|DFP|DID|FND|MLP|OOB|RAMB|SMA → apply matching skill → revalidate

skills.pattern: ChatHLS catalog error APT (APT). Related: #pragma,Array,Memory,Index,Pointers. Trigger when synthesis/csim/cosim logs or code review match this class.
skills.strategy: APT = wrong array_partition type= (complete|block|cyclic). ONLY change the partition type to match the access pattern. Do not change dim (that is DID) or factor (that is FND). Complete → element registers (good for small windows / pointer-cast index access). Block → contiguous chunks in separate memories. Cyclic → round-robin banks for unrolled consecutive accesses. Example: pool_window accessed via pointer casting needs complete, not cyclic.
required_steps: confirm #pragma HLS array_partition is present and the failure is about type, not dim/factor
inspect how the array is indexed (sequential, blocked, unrolled consecutive, pointer cast)
set type=complete|block|cyclic to match that pattern
leave dim= and factor= unchanged unless DID/FND evidence appears
re-run csim/csynth
guards: only apply APT fixes when this error class is actually present
do not insert unrelated pragmas just because this error type exists in the catalog
keep functional semantics identical unless the catalog example requires a structural rewrite
do not confuse APT (partition type) with DID (dimension) or FND (factor not divisible)

skills.pattern: ChatHLS catalog error DFP (DFP). Related: #pragma,dataflow,structure,function,pipeline. Trigger when synthesis/csim/cosim logs or code review match this class.
skills.strategy: DFP = illegal DATAFLOW process/buffer structure: multi-writer or multi-reader locals, non-canonical region body, or tasks that break single-producer/single-consumer. Fix by fusing producers/consumers, ping-pong distinct buffers, streams, or moving RMW ports outside the DATAFLOW region.
